title: Sugar Beetroot
body:
![alt text](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/982/592/image_2024-10-05_134506836.png)

Craft Sugar with beetroots !

This innovative addition allows players to craft sugar using the beetroot, expanding your agricultural options and sweetening your culinary creations.


__**Features:**__


**New Crafting Recipe**: Combine beetroots with water in a crafting table to produce sugar. No more relying solely on sugarcane!

**Enhanced Farming**: Grow and harvest beetroots in your fields, adding variety to your crops and ensuring you always have a source of sugar at hand.

**Culinary Uses**: Use the new sugar crafting option to create delicious recipes like cakes, potions, and more, all while incorporating the vibrant beetroot into your meals.

![alt text](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/982/722/beetroot-sugar.png)

Bring sweetness to your world with the Sugar Beetroot mod and discover new ways to utilize beetroots in your Minecraft adventures!
